vulnerability_behavior.preconditions_for_vulnerability: Lack of proper access control to restrict unauthorized inspection of kernel stack contents.

solution_behavior.description: To mitigate the vulnerability, it is necessary to restrict access to inspect the kernel stack of an arbitrary task to only root users. This ensures that unauthorized users cannot exploit racy stack unwinding to leak sensitive kernel task stack contents.
